summary: BERGEN ROBOTIKK AS (org. no. 935 338 123) is a private limited company (AS) based in Øygarden, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2025-04-08. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.100 (Dataprogrammeringstjenester); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 47 314. CEO: Kjell-Inge Jørgensen; board chair: Kjell-Inge Jørgensen.
